create_sim_helper: create a Habitat simulator instance with a given scene ID and RGB camera sensor configuration
show_img: display or save an RGB observation image from the Habitat simulator to a file or notebook
show_scene: render and display the current scene from the camera node's transformation in the simulator
draw_axes: draw colored coordinate axes at a given translation using the simulator's debug line renderer
calc_camera_transform: calculate a look-at camera transformation matrix from an eye position and target point
